start.text: The skies over the grand summit darken to a deep obsidian purple. Odin, the Allfather of the Norse Pantheon, descends upon a metallic eight-legged steed, flanked by Thor, the God of Thunder. 'Musa! You broke the tracking grids of the lesser empires. Hand over the Golden Scar, or your mortal realm faces total ragnarok.'
start.name: Odin Allfather

choices.text: 🤝 Betray your human allies and trade Mansa Musa II's locations to Odin for safety
⚔️ Rebel with absolute free will and attack Odin directly with your scar magic
🏃‍♂️ Order a strategic retreat into the deeper industrial catacombs

betray_mansa.text: You prioritize your own survival, handing over the encryption frequencies to Mansa Musa II’s corporate fortress. Odin nods with a cold, transactional stare. Thor flies down, instantly obliterating the human resistance base. Your conscience burns, but your pockets run deep.
betray_mansa.name: Thor

choices.text: Claim your blood-money commission from the Norse vanguard

fight_odin_check.text: You reject submission, unleashing a searing jet of gold bullion magic directly at the Allfather. But Odin is a primordial cosmic entity, centuries older than your magic core. His runic spear Gungnir deflects your blast instantly, sending a punishing feedback shockwave straight through your neural grid.
fight_odin_check.name: System

choices.text: Cough up blood and stagger backward into the smoke

tactical_retreat.text: Recognizing the vast power disparity, you command your vanguard to drop smoke barriers. You slip down a heavy ventilation shaft, leading your people deep into the dark subterranean metro grid. You saved your faction from a total massacre.
tactical_retreat.name: Narrator

choices.text: Regroup inside the concrete industrial bunkers

norse_outpost.text: The city landscape has turned into a fractured, war-torn zone. Norse dreadnoughts patrol the skies, while remnants of the Roman Centurions attempt to lock down the lower districts. The battle lines are completely blurred.
norse_outpost.name: System

choices.text: ⏩ Advance into the shifting tactical warzone

end_of_chapter.text: Free-will decision vectors logged into core database. Compiling narrative path variables... Loading Chapter 10 asset structures.
end_of_chapter.name: System

defeat.text: Your survival vitality hits 0%. The golden tracking runes on your skin shatter as your life force fades into the dark rain.
defeat.name: System
